subject: Three-way bakeoff: request for accelerated credit & competitive match
messages:
From: Lisa Moreno <lisa@mediform.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.nguyen@mediform.com
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: RFP: three-way bakeoff — can Redwood escalate credits?

Dylan,

Thanks for the call earlier — quick follow up. We’re running a tight three-way bakeoff next month (Mediform, Redwood, and two other vendors) to validate inference latency/cost and hallucination rates for our chart-extraction use case. Procurement asked if vendors can provide a competitive credit package that mirrors what the incumbent is offering (they mentioned a 100k token equivalent stipend + 2-week extended trial).

Can Redwood match that level, and are you able to expedite allocation so our engineers can start parallel runs next Monday? Also: we’ll need the credits tied to a scoped dataset and an NDA before we share the test corpus.

Attachments: mediform_bakeoff_scope.xlsx (high-level test cases).

Appreciate a fast answer — procurement has a short window.

Best,
Lisa Moreno
Sr. Product Manager | Mediform Health
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Moreno <lisa@mediform.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-20T12:34:00-04:00
Subject: Re: RFP: three-way bakeoff — can Redwood escalate credits?

Thanks Lisa — really appreciate the context and the scope doc. Two quick notes up front:

- We can usually provide promotional credits for bakeoffs of this scale; need to confirm exact token allotment and any competitive-match clause.
- We’ll need the signed NDA before we provision the environment and the scoped dataset access.

Looping in Monica (allocations/ops) and Karthik (pricing approvals) to propose a package. Monica — can you draft a baseline offer (tokens + duration) that’s ready for a procurement response? If procurement expects parity with the incumbent, note any restrictions (time-limited, non-transferable, single account use).

I’ll hold a 30-min slot tomorrow in case you want to talk through the corpus and acceptance criteria.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, lisa@mediform.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-21T10:00:00-04:00
Subject: Proposed pilot credit package for Mediform bakeoff

Hi all — following up with a concrete proposal so procurement has something to review.

Proposal (draft):
- Promotional credit: 120,000 token-equivalent (measured and invoiced in token units per standard policy)
- Trial window: 3 weeks active from provisioning (can request one 1-week extension subject to review)
- Usage scope: single test project tied to Mediform account MF-2027-045; non-transferable
- Deliverables: access to Redwood hosted endpoint, 24/7 sandbox provisioning within 48 hours of signed NDA, up to 2 concurrent test workers
- Attachments: redwood_credit_proposal_20270421.pdf; draft_mpa_redwood.docx (standard MPA with promotional credit schedule)

Notes:
- Because the bakeoff includes two direct competitors, we’re treating this as a competitive evaluation. We can match token counts at the upper bound (120k) but require the signed MPA + NDA and a short acceptance form after the run to capture performance metrics for audit.
- If Mediform needs the 2-week extension mentioned, indicate which week is highest priority and we’ll expedite review.

Lisa — does this match procurement expectations? Happy to iterate.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enablement & Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, lisa@mediform.com
Date: 2027-04-21T15:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed pilot credit package for Mediform bakeoff

Monica — proposed package looks good. Two commercial points from pricing/legal: 

1) Competitive-match clause: we can match published token stipend up to 120k, but we do NOT allow explicit language that requires benchmarking against a named competitor as a condition of credits — we’ve seen legal exposure there. We’ll accept ‘three-way competitive evaluation’ language but not a named-competitor clause.
2) Extension approvals: we can pre-approve a single 1-week extension; anything beyond that will require Ops signoff and usage review.

I’ve added the HubSpot deal MF-2027-045 and attached an internal approval note to the record. Once Mediform confirms scope and signs the MPA and NDA we can trigger provisioning.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Commercials | Redwood Inference

--
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/MF-2027-045
From: Lisa Moreno <lisa@mediform.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.nguyen@mediform.com, monica.patel@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-22T09:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed pilot credit package for Mediform bakeoff

Thanks — the draft package looks workable. A couple of asks before I route to procurement:

- We can accept the 120k token promo, but procurement wants the trial extended to 4 weeks total (they noted team availability across two sprints). You said a 1-week extension is pre-approved — can we get that in writing?
- Procurement also asked whether the credits can be used to run a side-by-side comparison against CompetitorX; they prefer naming competitors explicitly in the evaluation document. Based on Karthik’s note, I’ll remove the named-competitor clause from the procurement template and keep it generic (three-way evaluation).

If you can confirm the 4-week total window and confirm we’ll have sandbox access within 48 hours of NDA signature, I’ll start the procurement packet and send the NDA over today.

Best,
Lisa
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Moreno <lisa@mediform.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-22T16:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed pilot credit package for Mediform bakeoff — confirmation

Lisa — confirmed.

- Total window: 4 weeks (3 weeks standard + 1-week extension pre-approved) starting from provisioning date. We’ll include that explicitly in the MPA section.
- Sandbox provisioning: confirmed within 48 hours after we receive a countersigned NDA and the acceptance form.
- Competitive wording: we’ll accept a generic ‘multi-vendor comparative evaluation’ clause (no named-competitor requirement).

Next steps:
1) Lisa — send NDA and the acceptance form.
2) Monica — hold 120k token promo pending signed docs; provision within 48 hours once docs are in.
3) Karthik — please confirm internal record and finalize HubSpot deal note for finance.

I’ll follow up with the PDF and MPA draft attached to procurement once we have the NDA.

Thanks everyone — we’ll move fast on this.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_credit_proposal_20270421.pdf, draft_mpa_redwood.docx
